pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: scripts/security/secret-scan.mjs:202 The secret scan's pass states the property ('no committed credential') even though its key includes an author-movable path exemption (any README.md, docs/), so the green reports as a ceiling when it is really a floor of listed shapes outside exempt paths.

techniques.evidence: scripts/security/secret-scan.mjs:99 Location key: a real key pasted into any README.md (or docs/) is exempt, and the pass message at :202 claims the property rather than declaring itself a floor.

scripts/security/check-actions.mjs:585 A missing workflow dir becomes zero files, which leads to zero findings and the 'every action is pinned' message with exit 0. Could-not-run folds into pass, though the check-actions fixture's readdirSync on the real dir partly backstops it.

scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:334 Gate scripts, ratchet files and quarantine are protected. Test sources, helpers and fixtures are only protected against DELETION, so a dispatched agent can still weaken (rewrite) the test it is asked to make pass.
scripts/security/check-actions.mjs:25 The network-dependent --resolve is split off from the offline, tree-deterministic ratchet that blocks.
scripts/security/check-actions.mjs:706 The exit code is tied directly to blocking-severity findings. 'warn' notes cannot fail the build, by construction.
scripts/security/secret-scan.mjs:40 Entropy and bare-prefix rules are excluded on purpose so that a match is worth stopping a build for.
scripts/security/secret-scan.mjs:212 The refusal names the remedy that actually fixes it (rotation) and the sanctioned place for example shapes.
scripts/security/check-actions.mjs:184 Each pin exception waives exactly one action@ref, carries a why, and a stale entry is itself blocking. Secrets are un-waivable (secret-scan.mjs:25).
scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:197 The ceiling override lives where the gated agent cannot write during the run it would authorize.
scripts/agent/budget.mjs:122 Missing usage is metered as unknown or estimated (rounded up, still spends the ceiling, never priced) rather than as zero.
scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:150 The hand list of protected paths is checked against a set derived from the gates CI actually runs.
scripts/security/check-actions.mjs:5 A prose claim ('every action is pinned') that was false outside ci.yml is now mechanised repo-wide.
scripts/security/check-actions.mjs:59 It explicitly states that run-injection's green does not cover the quoting question, and adds a separate rule for it.
